mainText: Hello, Verona! At 6 AM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 50 degrees with clear skies near Reddan Soccer Park and we are currently under a first quarter moon.
The City of Verona uses the VHAT cable channel to broadcast government meetings and community news. You can also stay updated by subscribing to the monthly digital newsletter on the city website.
We have a busy day ahead with Yoga at Insight Wellness, Concerts in the Park, and trivia at Hop Haus Brewing Company all happening today.
In a report from July 13, police officers handled a situation where a driver was arrested for O-W-I after their vehicle was found stuck on a large rock.
Culver's is currently closed but will open at 10 AM today. If you missed out, the flavor of the day is Really Reese's, and tomorrow you can look forward to the Chocolate Volcano flavor.
